finalReport:
# OpenCut — Current Architecture and Technology Stack

## Overview
OpenCut is a free, open-source, privacy-first CapCut alternative for web, desktop, and mobile, focused on simplicity and ease of use [Architecture](https://www.mintlify.com/OpenCut-app/OpenCut/development/architecture). It is local-first: video processing happens in the browser via FFmpeg.wasm and videos never leave the user's device [Architecture](https://www.mintlify.com/OpenCut-app/OpenCut/development/architecture).

> Note on versions: docs describe the classic shipping version (Turborepo + Next.js + EditorCore). The GitHub main branch states **OpenCut is being rewritten from the ground up** toward a Rust core shared across web/desktop/mobile, with `opencut.app` still running classic and the rewrite at `new.opencut.app` [GitHub](https://github.com/OpenCut-app/OpenCut). This report covers both, labeling rewrite status.

## 1. High-level architecture & repo structure

**Classic (documented) monorepo:**
OpenCut uses a Turborepo monorepo with `apps/web` (Next.js app with `components, core, hooks, lib, services, stores, types, utils`) and `packages/ui` + `packages/env`, plus `docker-compose.yml` and `turbo.json` [Architecture](https://www.mintlify.com/OpenCut-app/OpenCut/development/architecture). Conventions: `lib/` for domain logic/commands/video processing, `utils/` for generic helpers, `services/` for external integrations, `core/` for the EditorCore singleton/manager system [Architecture](https://www.mintlify.com/OpenCut-app/OpenCut/development/architecture).

**Current (rewrite) structure:**
- `apps/web/`: Next.js web app
- `apps/desktop/`: Native desktop app built with GPUI (in progress)
- `rust/`: Platform-agnostic core: GPU compositor, effects, masks, and WASM bindings, with business logic actively migrating from TypeScript
- `docs/`: Architecture/subsystem docs [GitHub](https://github.com/OpenCut-app/OpenCut)

**EditorCore pattern:**
Singleton `EditorCore` manages editor state via specialized managers: command, playback, timeline, scenes, project, media, renderer, save, audio, selection [Architecture](https://www.mintlify.com/OpenCut-app/OpenCut/development/architecture). Managers use EventEmitter3 observer to notify subscribers; React accesses via `useEditor()` hook, non-React via `EditorCore.getInstance()` [Architecture](https://www.mintlify.com/OpenCut-app/OpenCut/development/architecture). UX layers on top: Actions (`lib/actions/definitions.ts` + `use-editor-actions.ts`, invoked via `invokeAction()` with toasts/validation/shortcuts) and Commands (`lib/commands/` by domain, Command pattern for undo/redo) [Architecture](https://www.mintlify.com/OpenCut-app/OpenCut/development/architecture). DB access follows repository pattern in `src/lib/db/` [Architecture](https://www.mintlify.com/OpenCut-app/OpenCut/development/architecture).

Rewrite goals: Editor API, plugin-first architecture for third-party plugins, one Rust core for desktop/mobile/browser, MCP server for AI agents, headless mode, in-editor scripting tab [GitHub](https://github.com/OpenCut-app/OpenCut).

## 2. Frontend stack

- **Framework/language:** Next.js 16 with App Router, React 19, TypeScript [Architecture](https://www.mintlify.com/OpenCut-app/OpenCut/development/architecture)
- **Styling/UI:** Tailwind CSS 4, Radix UI primitives, Motion for animations [Architecture](https://www.mintlify.com/OpenCut-app/OpenCut/development/architecture)
- **State:** Zustand lightweight management [Architecture](https://www.mintlify.com/OpenCut-app/OpenCut/development/architecture), split as: EditorCore managers for editor state (timeline/playback/scenes) via `useEditor()`, Zustand stores in `src/stores/` for UI prefs/panel/dialogs/feature flags, React state for local inputs/temporary/animation state [Architecture](https://www.mintlify.com/OpenCut-app/OpenCut/development/architecture)

## 3. Backend, storage & deployment

- **Database/auth/cache:** PostgreSQL primary DB, Drizzle ORM type-safe access, Redis for caching/rate-limiting, Better Auth [Architecture](https://www.mintlify.com/OpenCut-app/OpenCut/development/architecture)
- **Client storage (local-first):** IndexedDB for projects/settings and OPFS (Origin Private File System) for large media files, via `lib/storage/` abstraction; flow: Import → store in OPFS → timeline/preview → export via FFmpeg → download [Docs](https://opencut.dev/)
- **Infra:** Docker Compose with `postgres:17`, `redis:7-alpine`, `serverless-redis-http` adapter, plus web container; dev: `docker compose up -d db redis serverless-redis-http`, `DATABASE_URL`, `BETTER_AUTH_*`, `UPSTASH_REDIS_*` env [Install](https://opencut-app-opencut.mintlify.app/installation)
- **Build toolchain:** Turborepo, Bun runtime/package manager, Biome linter/formatter, Docker [Architecture](https://www.mintlify.com/OpenCut-app/OpenCut/development/architecture)

## 4. Video editing / rendering / media

- **Classic engine:** FFmpeg.wasm in-browser processing, WaveSurfer.js waveforms, HTML Canvas preview [Architecture](https://www.mintlify.com/OpenCut-app/OpenCut/development/architecture)
- **In-progress refactor:** HTML/CSS/Canvas preview (inconsistent with export) → binary rendering engine like CapCut for consistent preview/export, performance and quality; contributors told to avoid preview/export changes during refactor [Architecture](https://www.mintlify.com/OpenCut-app/OpenCut/development/architecture)
- **New engine:** `opencut-wasm` — shared editor logic compiled to WebAssembly from `rust/crates/`, consumed by web app as published package or local `bun link` build [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencut-wasm). Rust core provides GPU compositor, effects, masks, WASM bindings [GitHub](https://github.com/OpenCut-app/OpenCut).

## Remaining uncertainties
- Exact Next.js/React version in rewrite vs classic docs (docs say Next 16/React 19; lockfiles observed at Next 15.4/React 18 in history) — fast-moving rewrite; pin to docs + branch date.
- Desktop implementation shifted from Tauri (older docs) to GPUI native (current README) — reflects rewrite churn.
- No contradictions recorded; all claims SUPPORTED.

Scope: OpenCut's current architecture and tech stack — repo structure, frontend, backend/infra, and video engine.

Key findings:
- Privacy-first open-source CapCut alternative, local-first via FFmpeg.wasm; classic Turborepo monorepo (apps/web + EditorCore singleton) now rewriting to Rust core + WASM for web/desktop/mobile.
- Frontend: Next.js 16 App Router, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind 4, Radix UI, Zustand, Motion; layered EditorCore / Zustand / React state.
- Backend: PostgreSQL + Drizzle, Better Auth, Redis/Upstash, IndexedDB + OPFS client storage, Docker Compose, Bun/Turborepo/Biome.
- Video: FFmpeg.wasm + Canvas preview moving to binary/Rust GPU compositor via opencut-wasm, WaveSurfer for audio.

Uncertainty: fast-moving rewrite — version pins (Next 16/React 19 vs older lockfiles) and desktop (Tauri → GPUI) reflect churn; no contradictions.
